name: Recompile all transformations
description: Recompile all regular transformations in repository
statement:
/*
Script to compile all transformations h<h<h<
*/

DECLARE
	@TransformationID int = -1,
	@DB sysname = 'dwh_' + RIGHT(DB_NAME(), LEN(DB_NAME()) - 5)

WHILE 1=1
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1
		@TransformationID = TransformationID
	FROM
		CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS
	WHERE
		TransTypeID IN (1, 7) AND --regular or union 
		TransformationID > @TransformationID
	ORDER BY
		TransformationID

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

	EXEC CFG.CREATE_TRANS_VIEW @TransformationID, @DB, :1
END
